The [Federal Open Market Committee](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/banking/article/federal-open-market-committee-140029594.html) (FOMC) — a division of the Federal Reserve responsible for setting monetary policy — will soon meet again to evaluate the health of the economy and make key decisions regarding the [federal funds rate](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/mortgages/article/federal-funds-rate-194457132.html). _Read more:_[_Why you should open a CD account before the Fed's next meeting_](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/banking/article/should-you-open-a-savings-account-cd-before-fed-meeting-231620735.html). Then the Fed Chairman holds a press conference at 2:30 p.m. _Read more:_[_How a Fed rate cut affects your bank accounts, loans, credit cards, and investments_](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/banking/article/how-a-fed-rate-cut-affects-your-bank-accounts-loans-credit-cards-and-investments-220526212.html). Due to rising [inflation](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/banking/article/inflation-definition-195527231.html), experts believe that the Fed will not reduce the federal funds rate again in 2026. Here's what to expect.](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/banking/article/what-time-is-the-fed-meeting-120032257.html "What time is the Fed meeting?").

## ​The next scheduled FOMC (Federal Open Market Committee) meeting will be on April 28–29, 2026. The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meets eight scheduled times a year to discuss and set monetary policy, and its decisions have a major impact on financial markets, mortgage rates, and economic growth. ## What is the FOMC? The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) is the branch of the Federal Reserve responsible for setting monetary policy for the US. ## What date is the next FOMC meeting? The Federal Reserve has scheduled its next FOMC meeting for April 28–29, 2026. At the end of each meeting, the FOMC announces its decisions on U.S. interest rates, followed by a press conference led by the Federal Reserve Chair. At its **March 18, 2026** meeting, the FOMC **kept the target range for the federal funds rate unchanged** **at 3.50% to 3.75%**. The Federal Open Market Committee is composed of twelve members, each with expertise in economics and monetary policy.

# When is the next Fed interest rate decision? ## The next Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision is due on Wednesday, April 29, 2026, at 18:00 GMT. The US Federal Reserve (Fed) announces its decisions regarding interest rates eight times a year during Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings., approximately every six weeks. ## What is the Fed interest rate? At its latest meeting on **March 18, 2026**, the FOMC **held interest rates unchanged**. ## What date is the next Federal Reserve interest rate meeting? **The next Federal Reserve meeting is scheduled for April 28–29, 2026.**‍. The federal funds rate target range is currently set at **3.50% to 3.75%**, where it was **left unchanged at the Federal Reserve’s latest meeting on March 18, 2026**, following a series of rate cuts in late 2025. ### What is the effect when the Federal Reserve increases interest rates? ## What time is the Fed rate decision? ### **Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate**.
